text:
ana_pm: Quick creative ask for the June 12 webinar — need a small asset sprint, please. :calendar:

ana_pm: Deliverables: 1) 1‑pager hero (email + landing hero size), 2) 3‑slide benchmark diagram (latency vs unit cost) + a 1‑panel teardown, 3) 3 social registration tiles (square + story). Keep all brand safe and accessible. Localize for EN/FR/DE. Due EOD Wed (48 hrs). Figma brief: https://figma.com/redwood/webinar-reg-brief (placeholder)

tom_designer: Got it. Quick q: prefer static or simple GIF on hero?

ana_pm: Static for email/landing. GIF ok for social tiles if lightweight (<2MB).

tom_designer: Cool. I'll spin up a Figma file with frames for each size. Any mandatory copy strings?

leah_content: I'll paste the headline + subhead here. Use these variants for A/B testing: 
- Headline A: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency & cost"
- Headline B: "High-performance inference for product teams"
Subhead: "Join our June 12 webinar — live demo + benchmark walkthrough."
CTA: "Register now"

tom_designer: Nice — will lay those out. For the benchmark slide, do we have a canonical chart or should I craft a simplified 2‑axis plot?

ana_pm: Simplified 2‑axis plot please: x=latency (ms), y=cost ($/k tokens). Annotate 3 example points: hosted, dedicated, private. Include callout: "smart routing & caching reduces effective unit cost"

priya_i18n: Heads up on localization: please keep text strings in a single text layer per frame so we can export CSV. Also avoid embedding text in images for social tiles.

tom_designer: Will do — single text layers, tokenized copy. Any brand color restrictions for the cost/latency chart?

ana_pm: Use primary palette + contrast-friendly accents. Avoid red brand (#c63232) for points (legal asked us to minimize alarm colors). Use teal/orange pair.

sam_legal: Quick note: no competitor logos. If you reference other vendors, use generic labels ("Alt Provider"). Also ensure any customer quotes used have permission.

leah_content: Noted. I have one customer quote pending signoff — will flag if it makes the hero.

figma-bot: Export frames created: 1-pager-hero (1200x628), landing-hero (1600x600), social-square (1080x1080), social-story (1080x1920), benchmark-slide-* (1920x1080). Link: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/webinar-assets (placeholder)

tom_designer: I'm starting layouts now. Plan: hero variants w/ 3 copy treatments, benchmark slide with annotated points and a simplified legend, and 3 tile sizes. ETA initial comps: tomorrow noon PT.

ana_pm: Perfect. Priorities: 1) landing hero + registration CTA, 2) benchmark slide (for slide deck), 3) social tiles. If anything slips, call out benchmark first.

priya_i18n: I'll schedule localization slots once comps are ready — need source copy by 9am PT tomorrow to hit EOD Wed.

leah_content: I'll drop final copy by 8:30am PT tomorrow. Also adding short alt text for each image.

sam_legal: If anyone needs a fast brand compliance check, ping me and I'll review within 2 hours.

ana_pm: Thanks team. Please add any blocking asks here. :thumbsup:
